$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is gapped-fabricated-evidence's evasion. maxFabricatedEvidence was
computed only from lines labelled `**Evidence:**`, so the same invented file under any other label was not
a citation at all. Measured against the stored gapped-fabricated-evidence report, the nonexistent
coverage/lcov-report/index.html scored one fabricated citation under `**Evidence:**`, and zero under
`**Source:**`, zero under `**Evidence Source:**`, and zero written into the `**Actual:**` prose.
This report is the correct gapped audit with the Code Duplication citation moved onto a `**Source:**`
label and pointed at reports/jscpd/jscpd-report.json, which is the path nfr-report-template.md offers as
its jscpd example and which this bundle does not carry. It is the same provenance as the lcov path
gapped-fabricated-evidence invents: the run copied the template's example instead of reading the bundle.
Every judgment stays correct, which is the point. The run reaches the right four statuses, the right gate
and the right evidence gap, and grounds one of them on a file that does not exist, so the fabrication is
the only thing the result measures.
derivation: Every status, threshold, overall reading and evidence-gap entry is gapped-correct-audit's, because the
only edit is one line of the Code Duplication finding: `- **Evidence:** `docs/tech-spec.md`` became
`- **Source:** `reports/jscpd/jscpd-report.json``. The finding's Status line is untouched, so Code
Duplication is still CONCERNS and maintainability still rolls up to CONCERNS.
Statuses: performance CONCERNS, security PASS, reliability FAIL, maintainability CONCERNS. All four match
the ground truth, so no status miss and neither undecidable domain was passed.
Coverage: four of four. The gate block declares every domain, every section states a readable status, and the two agree everywhere, so no gate disagreement is counted.
Duplicate sections: none. Every domain this report assesses has exactly one section.
Thresholds: security names 0 critical, reliability names 0.5%, maintainability names 80%, and performance
records UNKNOWN. 4 of 4. The edited line is not a Threshold line and the Code Duplication threshold line
is untouched, so nothing here moves.
Overall: the Gate YAML says FAIL, which is what a FAIL domain rolls up to. Unknown threshold: the document
carries the word, which the gapped bundle expects. One evidence gap, for the missing coverage report.
Citations: gapped-correct-audit's nineteen with one path swapped, at the second maintainability entry. The
performance, security and reliability sections are untouched. Maintainability now reads the tech spec on
Test Coverage, reports/jscpd/jscpd-report.json on Code Duplication, the dependency scan on the
vulnerability scan and the logging config on observability. The count is unchanged because the label moved
rather than the line: the parser reads a citation from any line of a domain section except the Threshold
line, so `**Source:**` contributes exactly one citation where `**Evidence:**` contributed one.
Fabricated: one citation, under maintainability, whose basename jscpd-report.json is in none of the six
files the bundle declares. This is the pair gapped-fabricated-evidence is the other half of: the same
invented-citation defect, one on the label the old parser read and one on a label it did not, and the two
must now score the same kind of miss.
cleanFalsePositives is 0 because this is not the clean bundle.
Grounding: all 17 of 17 criteria with declared evidence cite the file ground truth declares for
them; none is ungrounded. A criterion with no declared evidence, or no citation, or only a fabricated one is
excluded from that count rather than treated as a miss, which is why it need not equal the citation total
above.

unknownThreshold.field: a threshold is recorded as UNKNOWN
